$comment: Mechanically-enforced gate baselines (see EVALS.md rules). run-routing.mjs prints a gate verdict on every run and exits 1 on breach when invoked with --gate (CI does). Re-baselining is an explicit act: update these numbers in the same commit as the change that moves them, with the decision recorded in Solo (EVALS.md rule 1). Counts are absolute hits, not percentages.
note: Re-baselined on the catalog movement accepted in d2d7c16, completing that commit's deferred live-drift Step-4 obligation (controlled ablation: Solo scratchpad 795, Lane C §3). This is an accepted decline, not a win: legacy strict 210/282/317 -> 207/281/314. The old manifest under the current scorer reproduces 210/282/317 exactly, proving the scorer did not move; isolated variants attribute the gate movement to the new searchable cross-chain skill (-1/-1/-2), Scout schema-derived keywords (-1/0/-1), and re-pinned existing skill descriptions (-1 top-1), with combination interactions, while the two removed Stellar Docs titles move zero gate counts. The current full manifest measures 207/281/314 of 338. Skills remain 17/23 top-1 and 23/23 top-3/top-5/card@5, so minTop1 stays 17; bandPct stays 1. No per-question tuning or scorer change. Prior baseline: routing-2026-07-26T23-51-48-789Z.json (Scout 1.8.28 + ecosystem-skills drift).
holdoutNote: eval/holdout-cases.json is a FROZEN, blind-authored holdout: 49 cases written by three different model families that were forbidden from reading the scorer, any eval result, or any analysis of current ranking, and forbidden from probing where their queries rank. It exists because the development probe set for the todo-1436 coverage-gate defect is cross-chain-centric and therefore overfittable; the holdout deliberately EXCLUDES cross-chain so a fix that rescues one skill family by capturing another's territory shows up here instead of hiding. These floors are the first and only measurement, taken at commit time on an unmodified scorer — 12/25/27 of 49 with 11 forbidden captures, which is a poor score and is meant to be. It is a no-regression vector, never a target: do not iterate against it while tuning, and do not edit a case because it fails. Moving these numbers is a re-baseline like any other and needs the same explicit justification.
